captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a short, straight segment of a wooden-style toy train track. It features a flat rectangular body with two parallel grooves running along its length to guide train wheels. Each end of the track is equipped with a single protruding male peg, designed with a cylindrical head and a rectangular neck, allowing it to connect with other track pieces.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric toy train track segment in OpenSCAD. The design should feature a main track body with two parallel wheel grooves, and a male connector peg on each end. Allow the user to customize the length of the track segment using a single parameter.
captions.factory: The code generates the main track profile using a 2D polygon definition representing the cross-section with wheel grooves, which is then extruded using linear_extrude along the track_length axis and rotated into place. A separate 'peg' module is defined using a union of a cylinder and a cube to form the connector. Two instances of this peg module are translated to opposite ends of the track, with one rotated 180 degrees to face the opposite direction.
